newsitem.title: USA: Dlr holds on to early gains to end U.S. session up.
newsitem.headline: Dlr holds on to early gains to end U.S. session up.

text.p: Dollar/mark set its fifth high in as many trading days while dollar/yen fell just shy of matching Europe's 45-month peak after U.S. economic data soothed fears about inflation and higher interest rates.
The dollar surged to 1.5973 marks, its highest level since July 1994, following the release of subdued U.S. consumer price data and healthy retail sales figures for December.

"I think the dollar continues to benefit from strong economic growth and the perception of moderate to weak inflation in the United States," said John Nelson, a senior vice-president at ABN-AMRO Bank in New York.
